Sure! Below is a sample 7‑day “Paris Getaway” itinerary that balances iconic sights, local experiences, and a bit of downtime. Feel free to tweak dates, activities, or budget to match your preferences. --- ## 📅 Trip Overview | Day | Date | Theme | Highlights | |-----|------|-------|------------| | 1 | Arrival | Arrival & Orientation | Flight, hotel check‑in, evening stroll | | 2 | Classic Landmarks | Eiffel Tower, Seine cruise | | 3 | Art & Culture | Louvre, Palais Garnier | | 4 | Neighborhood Exploration | Montmartre, Sacré‑Coeur | | 5 | Day Trip | Versailles Palace & Gardens | | 6 | Food & Markets | Marché Bastille, cooking class | | 7 | Departure | Last‑minute shopping, departure | > **Total Duration**: 7 days > **Suggested Travel Dates**: May 10 – May 17 (spring, mild weather, fewer crowds than peak summer) --- ## ✈️ Flights & Transportation | Segment | Details | |---------|---------| | **Outbound** | Depart from your home city on **May 10** (morning flight). Example: JFK → CDG, 8 h flight. | | **Inbound** | Return on **May 17** (evening flight). Example: CDG → JFK, 8 h flight. | | **Airport Transfers** | • **Air France / SNCF** train (RER B) – €10 per person one‑way.
• Or a shared shuttle (~€25 per person). | | **Local Transport** | • Purchase a **Paris Visite** pass (valid for 3 or 5 days) – €27.50 (3 days) or €38.50 (5 days).
• Or use contactless payment (Apple Pay/Google Pay) for metro/bus. | --- ## 🏨 Accommodation | Option | Price Range (per night) | Notes | |--------|------------------------|-------| | **Mid‑Range** | €150–€200 | Hotel Le Marais, 2‑star boutique hotel in the Marais district. | | **Luxury** | €350–€450 | Hôtel Plaza Athénée, 5‑star near Avenue Montaigne. | | **Budget** | €80–€120 | Generator Paris Hostel, dormitory or private room. | > **Recommendation**: Stay in the **Marais** or **Saint‑Germain** neighborhoods for easy access to public transport and a lively dining scene. --- ## 🍽️ Dining & Food Highlights | Day | Activity | Suggested Restaurants | |-----|----------|------------------------| | 1 | Evening walk | **Le Petit Cler** (French bistro) | | 2 | Lunch | **Café Constant** (near Eiffel Tower) | | 3 | Dinner | **L’Arpège** (Michelin 3‑star, vegetable‑centric) | | 4 | Breakfast | **Café de Flore** (classic Parisian café) | | 5 | Picnic | **Jardin des Tuileries** (pick up baguette, cheese, wine) | | 6 | Cooking Class | **La Cuisine Paris** (French pastry workshop) | | 7 | Farewell | **Septime** (modern French cuisine, Michelin 1‑star) | > **Tip**: Reserve restaurants 2–3 weeks in advance, especially Michelin‑starred spots. --- ## 🎟️ Must‑See Attractions & Tickets | Attraction | Ticket Type | Price (adult) | Notes | |------------|-------------|---------------|-------| | Eiffel Tower | Skip‑the‑line | €25.90 | Book online 2 months ahead. | | Louvre | Standard | €17 | Free on first Sunday of month. | | Palais Garnier | Guided tour | €12 | Book via official website. | | Montmartre | Free | — | Visit Sacré‑Coeur, artists’ square. | | Versailles | Palace & Gardens | €20 | Book “Skip‑the‑line” ticket. | | Seine Cruise | Evening dinner cruise | €45 | Book 1 month ahead. | | Musée d’Orsay | Standard | €14 | Free on first Sunday of month. | > **Tip**: Use the official Paris Pass or Paris Museum Pass for bundled savings if you plan to visit many museums. --- ## 📅 Sample Daily Itinerary ### Day 1 – Arrival & Orientation - **Morning**: Arrive CDG, take RER B to Gare du Nord → hotel check‑in. - **Afternoon**: Explore the Marais, visit **Picasso Museum**. - **Evening**: Dinner at **Le Petit Cler**, stroll along the Seine. ### Day 2 – Classic Landmarks - **Morning**: Breakfast at **Café de Flore**. - **Mid‑morning**: Eiffel Tower (skip‑the‑line). - **Lunch**: **Café Constant**. - **Afternoon**: Walk through Champ de Mars, visit **Arc de Triomphe**. - **Evening**: Seine dinner cruise. ### Day 3 – Art & Culture - **Morning**: Louvre (early entry). - **Lunch**: **Le Café Marly** inside Louvre. - **Afternoon**: Musée d’Orsay. - **Evening**: Dinner at **L’Arpège** (reserve). ### Day 4 – Montmartre & Sacré‑Coeur - **Morning**: Tram to Montmartre, visit Sacré‑Coeur. - **Lunch**: **Le Consulat**. - **Afternoon**: Explore artists’ square, visit **Espace Dalí**. - **Evening**: Dinner at **La Maison Rose**. ### Day 5 – Versailles Day Trip - **Morning**: Train to Versailles (RER C), skip‑the‑line ticket. - **All day**: Palace, Gardens, Trianon Palaces. - **Evening**: Return to Paris, light dinner at **Bistro du Peintre**. ### Day 6 – Food & Markets - **Morning**: Visit **Marché Bastille** for fresh produce. - **Lunch**: Picnic in Jardin des Tuileries. - **Afternoon**: Cooking class at **La Cuisine Paris**. - **Evening**: Casual dinner at **Le Comptoir du Relais**. ### Day 7 – Departure - **Morning**: Last‑minute shopping on Rue Saint‑Honoré. - **Afternoon**: Check‑out, head to CDG via RER B. - **Evening**: Flight back home. --- ## 💰 Budget Snapshot (per person) | Category | Cost (EUR) | |----------|------------| | Flights | €650 | | Accommodation (mid‑range) | €1,050 | | Transport (airport + Paris pass) | €70 | | Meals | €400 | | Attractions & Tours | €250 | | Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | €100 | | **Total** | **≈ €2,620** | > **Note**: Prices fluctuate; book early for best rates. --- ## 📌 Tips & Tricks 1. **Book tickets online** for major attractions to avoid long queues. 2. **Use the Metro**: A single ride costs €1.90; a 10‑ride carnet is €14.90. 3. **Dining**: Try **bouchons** in Lyon‑style restaurants for hearty meals. 4. **Language**: Learn basic French phrases; locals appreciate effort. 5. **Safety**: Keep an eye on your belongings in crowded areas; use a money belt. 6. **Weather**: Pack layers; spring can be cool in the evenings. --- ### Want to customize? - **Add a day** for a visit to **Disneyland Paris** or **Giverny** (Monet’s garden). - **Swap** mid‑week for a **wine tasting** in the **Champagne** region. - **Adjust** accommodation to a boutique hotel in **Le Marais** or a luxury suite in **Champs‑Élysées**. Let me know if you’d like help booking tickets, making reservations, or tailoring the itinerary further!
